### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `net/wireless/core.c` and `net/wireless/pmsr.c` are closely related as they work together to resolve a deadlock issue that occurs when the interface is destroyed while holding a lock. The addition of the flush work in `core.c` ensures that any ongoing work is completed before the interface is deleted. Meanwhile, the refactoring in `pmsr.c` allows the abort logic to be executed directly while holding the necessary lock, thus preventing the deadlock situation. The changes ensure that the worker's logic is executed safely without causing a deadlock, maintaining the integrity of the locking mechanism.
